$schema-note: Paper-card JSON schema (documentation template, not a filled answer). Every field is either a value copied/checked against the cited paragraph, or the literal string NOT_REPORTED. Empty strings and null are never valid values.
audit_record: <step-5 claim-audit outcome: claims checked, corrected, dropped, conflicts kept>
gain_evidence: <scorecard from measure_gain.py (section coverage, anchored-claim ratio, fill, figure/table resolution), plus a baseline scorecard if one was run>

knowledge_points.definition: <definition as given in the paper, or NOT_REPORTED>
variants: <synonym / spelling variant found in the paper>

paper_card.data: <what data / samples / corpus / system the study uses: source, size, time span, selection criteria>
paper_card.key_findings: <main results with numbers and units where the paper gives them>
paper_card.limitations: <limitations the paper states, plus any the reader can verify from the method/data>
paper_card.methods: <method, model, instrument, procedure and key conditions/parameters>
paper_card.premises_for_conclusions: <the conditions under which each main conclusion holds: sample scope, parameter range, assumptions, controls -- this field is what makes a conclusion reusable without being over-generalised>
paper_card.research_question: <the question the paper sets out to answer, in the paper's own terms>
paper_card.title: <paper title, or NOT_REPORTED>

section_notes.conclusion: <conclusion drawn in this section, or NOT_REPORTED>

figures_tables.value_from_text: <value the citing text states about this figure/table, or NOT_REPORTED>

section_notes.link_to_next_section: <how this section hands over to the next one, e.g. 'the gap identified here motivates the method in s3'>
section_notes.method: <method detail given in this section, or NOT_REPORTED>
section_notes.purpose: <what this section is for, in the argument>
section_notes.result: <result reported in this section, or NOT_REPORTED>

uncertain_items: <anything not reported, conflicting, or unverifiable, with where you looked>
